title: 我的周末

explanations.1: Completes the weather description at the start.
explanations.2: Completes the phrase '不冷也不热' meaning not cold and not hot.
explanations.3: Indicates the time of day when the action happens.
explanations.4: Describes the action of getting out of bed.
explanations.5: The food that was eaten for breakfast.
explanations.6: A measure word for a cup of milk.
explanations.8: Used in a question to ask about activity.
explanations.9: Indicates the direction of going to the park.
explanations.10: Indicates the starting point of the journey.
explanations.11: Refers to the speaker's home as the starting point.
explanations.13: The objects that are many and beautiful in the park.
explanations.14: Emphasizes that all people (we) are happy.
explanations.15: Describes the emotional state of being happy.
explanations.17: The action of writing Chinese characters.
explanations.18: The object that was read for a while.
explanations.19: The person with whom the speaker cooked dinner.
explanations.20: Expresses the speaker's positive feeling about the weekend.

translation: This Saturday the weather was very good, not cold and not hot. In the morning I got up at seven. I ate bread and also drank a glass of milk. A friend asked me what I am doing today. I said: 'I am going to the park.' Then I set off from my home and went to the park with my friend. There were many beautiful flowers in the park. We were all very happy. At noon we went home and ate lunch. In the afternoon I was at home writing Chinese characters and also read a book for a while. In the evening I cooked with my mother. We ate rice and eggs. At night I went to sleep at nine. I really liked this weekend.
